Included places: Marketplaces; shops tagged supermarket, convenience, grocery, greengrocer, bakery, butcher, deli, food, farm or seafood.
Category boundaries and overlaps: Food retail and marketplaces. A place in Groceries is excluded from Shopping.

Included places: Pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, doctors and dentists; healthcare-tagged hospitals, clinics, doctors, dentists, physiotherapists, laboratories and centres.
Schools, kindergartens, colleges, universities and libraries.
Category boundaries and overlaps: Libraries can also count toward Culture.

Included places: Parks, non-residential gardens, playgrounds, sports centres, fitness centres, pitches, public swimming pools, squares, cinemas, theatres and arts centres.
Category boundaries and overlaps: Leisure, sports and public spaces. The inventory excludes school pitches, playgrounds, pools and gardens without mapped public access. Parks and eligible gardens can also count toward Nature. Cinemas, theaters and arts centers can also count toward Culture.

Included places: Restaurants, cafés, fast-food outlets, food courts, bars, pubs and ice-cream outlets.
Category boundaries and overlaps: Food and drink service, including restaurants, cafés and bars. A bakery tagged as both a bakery shop and a café can count in Groceries and Dining.

Included places: Any nonempty shop tag except no, vacant or yes, excluding facilities that also match Groceries. This includes non-food shops and services such as hairdressers.
OpenStreetMap rules: shop=* except no|vacant|yes; no Groceries membership
Category boundaries and overlaps: Retail and shop-tagged services outside Groceries, such as clothes shops and hairdressers.

Included places: Post offices, town halls, community centres, social centres, banks, police stations, fire stations and places of worship.

Parks, qualifying gardens, nature reserves, woods, forests and mapped water areas (including lakes, ponds, reservoirs and riverbanks). Water is reached at a shore connected to the walking network without crossing mapped obstacles, never at its centre; river centreline ways are excluded. Nature includes eligible named gardens, botanical gardens, and explicitly public gardens at least 5,000 m². Residential and private gardens are excluded. Existing pedestrian access checks apply.
OpenStreetMap rules: leisure=park|garden (see eligibility)|nature_reserve OR natural=wood|water (areas only for water) OR landuse=forest OR waterway=riverbank (areas only)
Category boundaries and overlaps: Nature includes eligible named gardens, botanical gardens, and explicitly public gardens at least 5,000 m². Residential and private gardens are excluded. Existing pedestrian access checks apply. Qualifying gardens can also count toward Recreation. A water destination uses a reachable shore location.

Included places: Libraries, cinemas, theatres, arts centres, concert halls, live-music venues and museums.
Category boundaries and overlaps: Libraries can also count toward Education. Cinemas, theaters and arts centers can also count toward Recreation.

Included places: The union of the Bus stops, Metro stations, Tram stops and Rail stations rules. Stop-position nodes alone do not qualify. No service frequency or onward journeys are measured.
OpenStreetMap rules: highway=bus_stop OR amenity=bus_station OR public_transport=platform|station AND bus=yes OR railway=station|halt AND (station=subway OR subway=yes) OR public_transport=platform|station AND subway=yes OR railway=tram_stop OR public_transport=platform|station AND tram=yes OR railway=station|halt AND no bus|tram|metro mode match OR public_transport=platform|station AND train=yes
Category boundaries and overlaps: These are passenger stops as destinations. Timetable trips, when provided, use a separate transport feed.

Included places: Mapped bus stops, bus stations and passenger platforms/stations explicitly tagged for buses.
OpenStreetMap rules: highway=bus_stop OR amenity=bus_station OR public_transport=platform|station AND bus=yes

Included places: Railway stations or halts tagged subway, and passenger platforms/stations explicitly tagged subway.
OpenStreetMap rules: railway=station|halt AND (station=subway OR subway=yes) OR public_transport=platform|station AND subway=yes

Included places: Tram stops and passenger platforms/stations explicitly tagged tram.
Railway stations or halts not already assigned bus, metro or tram; passenger platforms/stations explicitly tagged train.
OpenStreetMap rules: railway=station|halt AND no bus|tram|metro mode match OR public_transport=platform|station AND train=yes
